title: Kelvin Unified Finding v1
description: Canonical, versioned wire format for normalized vulnerability findings flowing worker -> Findings Service and for stored/exported findings. Replaces ad-hoc per-scanner payloads. Normative companion: docs/architecture/FINDING_SCHEMA.md (severity mapping, fingerprint algorithm, redaction rules, extension points).

schema_version.description: Major version of this schema. Minor revisions are additive and stay within the same major.

id.description: Server-assigned finding UUID. Absent at ingestion; servers MUST ignore any client-supplied value.

fingerprint.description: Server-computed dedup fingerprint (docs/architecture/FINDING_SCHEMA.md §5). Absent at ingestion; servers MUST recompute and MUST NOT trust a client-supplied value.

status.description: Analyst triage state. Server-side only; never accepted from scanner payloads.

title.description: Human-readable vulnerability title. MUST NOT contain captured secrets (enforced by ingestion lint, not this schema).

severity.description: Canonical severity. Adapters map tool-native scales per docs/architecture/FINDING_SCHEMA.md §4.

confidence.description: Adapter confidence in the finding, normalized to 0..1.

evidence.description: Evidence bundle. All payloads MUST be redacted before ingestion (docs/architecture/FINDING_SCHEMA.md §6); inline content is a size-capped preview, large artifacts are referenced via `artifact`.

scanner_meta.description: The ONLY extension point. Keys MUST be namespace-qualified (`<namespace>.<field>`); the `kelvin.` namespace is reserved for platform use. Unknown namespaced keys are tolerated (forward compatibility); unknown ROOT fields are rejected.

additionalProperties.description: Scalar extension values only; structures belong in dedicated schema revisions.

discovered_at.description: UTC RFC 3339 timestamp when the adapter observed the vulnerability.

asset.description: Hostname, IP address, or URL host of the affected asset (no scheme, no port).

endpoint.description: Absolute URL of the affected endpoint, or null/absent for host-level findings. Query strings and fragments MUST be stripped before submission; they are dropped by fingerprint normalization regardless.

method.description: HTTP method associated with the endpoint, when applicable. Not part of the v1 fingerprint.

vulnerability.description: Vulnerability identity. The fingerprint vulnerability key is derived by precedence: template_id > lowest CVE ID > CWE ID > normalized title slug (docs/architecture/FINDING_SCHEMA.md §5.3).

template_id.description: Engine-native stable identifier (e.g. Nuclei template id). Lowercased.

type.description: Aligned with the evidence table CHECK constraint (docs/architecture/DATA_MODEL.md §5.10).

content_type.description: Media type; parameters after ';' are permitted (e.g. application/http;message-type=response).

content_redacted.description: Inline redacted preview (default cap 64 KiB; ingestion enforces the cap with 422 on excess).

size_bytes.description: Size of the underlying artifact (10 MiB per-asset cap, THREAT_MODEL T-10).

redacted_fields.description: Explicit list of field paths / rule IDs that were redacted (may be empty only when no sensitive material was present). Required even when empty so redaction is always attested.

artifact.description: Descriptor for artifacts too large for inline preview; the object itself is uploaded out-of-band and referenced by checksum.

name.description: Adapter identity: nuclei, zap, nmap, openvas, trivy, or a registered custom adapter name.

adapter_version.description: Kelvin adapter semver (the normalizer), not the engine version.

run_id.description: Scanner run identifier; correlates all findings from one execution.
